Item.Description: Use code X if all the goods on a simple air waybill are to be shown on an accompanying pre-entry, where both the goods and the pre-entry must be produced to our Officer. ALL CAP GOODS MUST BE REPORTED AS CSR X.

Use code U if all the goods on a simple air waybill are included on a pre-entry (either on a C88 or input via CHIEF), but Customs do not normally require the goods to be produced for examination. It may also be used to indicate the presentation of a SAD copy 3 as described in paragraph 2.5 (b) of Notice 275 Export procedures, (where this is the Office of Exit at the external frontier). Note: Community Transit documents (T-Forms) should normally be presented as part of the inward vehicle processing. However, if not already presented (where this is the Office of Exit at the external frontier) they may be presented with the ERL and declared as CSR U.
Use code T if all the goods on a simple air waybill have been transhipped using CCS-UK transit/transhipment procedures. CSR T can also be used to describe through transhipment consignments at export.

Use code P if the simple air waybill is to be used as a pre-shipment advice for goods exported under the Simplified Clearance Procedure (SCP) and all the goods shown on the air waybill are to be exported under the SCP and only one CRN holder will be responsible for the post-shipment export declaration for all the goods on that air waybill. Note: If the post-shipment export declaration is to be made by more than one CRN holder for goods on a simple air waybill, use the procedure in paragraph 7.5 of Notice 216.

Use code N if a simple air waybill is used as a simplified pre-entry when all the goods on an air waybill are goods of no statistical interest. Write the CSR code N on the copy of the air waybill that is to be used as the simplified Pre-entry. The CRN should not be shown. Notice 275 Export procedures provides more information about goods of no statistical interest. See note below for completion of HAWBs. CSR N may also be used to declare the export of Post Office, Forces or Diplomatic mail.

Use code L if a simple air waybill is used as a simplified pre-entry when all the goods on the air waybill have a combined value of GBP599 or less and a combined weight of less than 1000 KG. Write the CSR code L in the top right hand corner of the air waybill that is to be used as the simplified pre-entry. Immediately to the right of L insert the sterling value of the goods (without the £ (pound) symbol). The CRN should not be shown. See note in chapter 7 of Notice 216 for completion of HAWBs.

Use code M if a master air waybill covers all the goods on one or more house air waybills. Note: Where consolidations contain individual consignments that are proper to CSR X or U, CSR X, or U must be used as appropriate, for the total consolidation. If a loader also uses an export computer system to control the following types of consignment, these special CSRs must be allocated.

Used for the shipment of: (a) Community Status goods from the UK to another Member State; (b) Community Status goods moving to another Member State via the UK, that is, on a Through air waybill; and (c) the on-carriage of imported Community Status goods to another UK airport.
Used for the onward carriage of Third Country or T1 status imported goods to another UK Customs airport for clearance.
Used for the inland movement of DOMESTIC consignments to another UK airport or port.
Used after Fallback (see Section 8), to inhibit the re-transmission of information already submitted manually, during the period of fallback.
Returned Exports. Used to inhibit a further 'flight-gone' message for Export consignments from certain 'put-back' aircraft or for consignments that have been off-loaded from a returning aircraft.
Used to inhibit a further 'flight-gone' message for consignments that have been 'short-shipped'
Used for consignments previously entered to Customs control at another location. These shipments may be accompanied by a C88 UK transit document (see paragraph 7.15 of Notice 216).
